**STEP 1 - Scene:** Plain cubed tofu (probably firm) on a white plate, with no visible sauce, oil, or side dishes. A small red speck on one cube may be a chili or paprika flake, too small to weigh.

**STEP 2 - Vessel:** A white square-ish side plate, about 20 cm across. Area = 3.14 × (10)² ≈ 314 cm². The QR-coded sheet beneath is not food.

**STEP 3 - Items:** About 8 tofu cubes, roughly 1.5 to 2.5 cm per side, with a few partial pieces.

**STEP 4 - Area:** The tofu covers about 15% of the plate (≈47 cm²), clustered in the center.

**STEP 5 - Volume:** 47 cm² × ~2 cm average pile height ≈ 94 ml.

**STEP 6 - Grams:** Tofu is dense, so using ~0.9 g/ml gives 94 × 0.9 ≈ 85 g. A piece-by-piece check (8 cubes of about 10 to 12 ml each, with some smaller) gives a similar 75 to 95 g.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Firm tofu ≈ 144 kcal/100 g, so 85 g × 1.44 ≈ 122 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** Eight tofu cubes on a side plate is plausible at roughly 85 g and about 120 kcal. The estimate is uncertain by ±20%, mainly from the tofu type and cube sizes.
